{{Quote|We have secured the city of Pontel.|OOM-14|audio=Pontel.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Pontel''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] inhabited by members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] population. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[subjugation of Parrlay]] during the initial stages of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]] spotted Naboo members near Pontel. The [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] proceeded to attack the city and secured it for the Trade Federation.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pontel was set to appear in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' within the first level of the Trade Federation campaign, titled "Beachhead," but it was ultimately cut from the final game. Audio regarding OOM-14's attack on the city was still included in the game's files when it was released.<ref name="GB" />
